recommendation: Keep the fixed commit. It completes the unapplied example/link and computable target-versioning portions of FHIR-27794 while preserving the later FHIR-48828 decision to keep MustSupport guidance in the profile description rather than restoring a separate notes section.
issue_request: FHIR-27794 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution requesting FHIR-I ownership for the Provenance Relevant History profile, explanation of the use case and soft MustSupport meaning, links from relevantHistory/eventHistory guidance to the profile, a conformant eventHistory example linked from the profile page, and a profiling mechanism to require Provenance.target to be version-specific.
initial_application: Git commit 71bd0587df partially applied the issue by changing the profile ownership to FHIR-I, adding profile intro/notes include support, improving the profile description, and linking Request.relevantHistory to the profile. Current source already retained FHIR-I ownership/contact, the use-case and MustSupport guidance in the profile description, and Request/Event profile references, but Provenance.target still only had prose saying the reference SHALL be version-specific and the listed MedicationRequest eventHistory example did not actually include a conformant eventHistory Provenance.
additional_context: FHIR-48828 later retained provenance-relevant-history in core as informative, replaced the profile description with the current soft-conformance/MustSupport text, and removed the separate MustSupport notes section, so this reconciliation preserved that later decision. FHIR-48829 retained the profile because Request/Event relevantHistory and eventHistory elements can point directly to it. Zulip and Confluence evidence confirmed the original FHIR-I use-case, example, and versioned-target concerns; the later FHIR-34343 discussion clarified that resolve-as-version-specific is not the profile constraint mechanism.
reconciliation: Added ElementDefinition.type.versioning=specific to Provenance.target in structuredefinition-profile-provenance-relevant-history.xml. Added a contained Provenance in medicationrequestexample1.xml that declares the provenance-relevant-history profile, uses a version-specific MedicationRequest target, supplies occurredDateTime, activity, and Author agent, and is referenced from MedicationRequest.eventHistory. Added notes on the profile page linking to that MedicationRequest eventHistory example.
source_changes: source/medicationrequest/medicationrequestexample1.xml: added a contained Provenance conforming to provenance-relevant-history and an eventHistory reference to it.
source/provenance/provenance-relevant-history-notes.xml: added an Examples section linking from the profile page to the MedicationRequest eventHistory example.
